title: Painted Resin Bust
summary: A high-detail resin bust produced from an existing 3D file and completed with detailed hand-painted finishing.
imageAlt: Hand-painted high-detail resin character bust in an artist workspace
challenge: The supplied model contained sculpted facial features, layered armor, and complex horn geometry that needed to print cleanly and support a detailed painted finish.
approach: The existing 3D file was reviewed and prepared for high-detail resin printing, then cleaned, assembled, primed, and hand painted to build the final colors, contrast, and metallic accents.
result: The completed display piece preserved the fine details of the supplied model and added a finished, presentation-ready painted surface.
